experiment.title: Locate the remaining GPU work
experiment.implementation: Split callback, buffer attribution and parser staged; real GPU behavior untested.
experiment.hypothesis: Shared matrices, attention/state or other operations account for the gap left by isolated matrix timings.
experiment.only_change: Deliberately split scheduled computational nodes into diagnostic intervals; never enable this in app launchers.
proof: CPU monotonic boundaries assign every computational GPU buffer once
No additional math op in an isolated interval
Explicit instrumentation overhead versus fresh control
stop_if: Callback event cap or excessive logs
experiment.limits: Splitting removes fusion and adds synchronization/command-buffer overhead. Costs rank diagnostic paths, not original kernel time or accelerator occupancy.

comparison.adoption_gate: At least 5 percent median complete-task improvement on the chosen workload, or useful capacity gain with an explicitly accepted speed tradeoff; no unexplained quality failure or new swap. Report control drift and all raw passes.
comparison.percentage_rules: TPS gain = 100*(candidate/control-1). Time reduction = 100*(1-candidate/control). Requires finite positive matched metrics. Do not add percentages from separate experiments.
